assets.exclude_note: What each package's own build makes: Windows x86-64 its runtime and the timezone library's code for it; Linux x86-64 the same and the zoneinfo data (tz.gyp target tzdata, which the Windows builds do not make); Linux arm64 and macOS the zoneinfo data (their own runtimes are not in this asset).
assets.description: Standalone runtimes for the platforms other than the package's own, built from this repository (commit 5c2c4d6e5114): Windows x86-32 and x86-64 and Linux x86-32 and x86-64 engines with their externals, the timezone library's code for them and its zoneinfo data; the Android runtime's Java layer (Runtime/Android/Classes), built from the same source; and the rest of the Android runtime with the timezone library's Android code, carried over unchanged from oxt-runtimes-1.15 (OpenXTalk Lite 1.15). See PROVENANCE.md in the archive.

assets.source: OXT-Beyond's CI builds win-x86, win-x86_64, linux-x86 and linux-x86_64 of commit 5c2c4d6e5114c7eb82c892b092bdaf7f848031ed, made with tools/oxt/make_runtimes_asset.py --builds; the Android Java layer built from the same commit by tools/ci/android_java.py build; the other Android parts from oxt-runtimes-1.15
